ابتلعنا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَعْنَا (ibtalaʕnā) /ib.ta.laʕ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اُبْتُلِعْنَا (ubtuliʕnā) /ub.tu.liʕ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
